claims.assertion: Mari Swa says a Taygetan destroyer missed required arrival notification, prompting two Alfratean Federation destroyers to intercept it; a Taygetan Alcyone-class battleship intervened with warning shots, and the Alfrateans withdrew.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She reports this as an August 2024 incident near Earth.

claims.assertion: Mari Swa says the Urmah flagship went to battle readiness under a mutual military-assistance treaty; a Federation representative later agreed the Alfrateans were too aggressive but asked Taygetan crews to follow arrival-notification protocol.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

review_flags: This is a first-person, unverifiable account of an alleged armed confrontation in Earth orbit.
coverage_gaps: The video also introduces Mari Swa's new assistant and contains unrelated medical conspiracy claims that are omitted.
